modules.name: Browser SPA
modules.description: Preact SPA with 163+ class-based components. Deck.gl/globe.gl maps, panel grid layout, Web Workers for ML/ONNX/vector search. App orchestration via data-loader + refresh-scheduler.

modules.name: Vercel Edge Functions
modules.description: 80+ edge endpoints. Plain JS (no build step), self-contained per domain. Shared helpers for CORS, rate-limit, API key validation, session tokens, HMAC grants, idempotency, bootstrap hydration.

modules.name: Server Shared Libraries
modules.description: Server-side code consumed by Edge Functions. Redis client, rate-limit engine, LLM integration, response caching, gateway factory (CORS + auth + cache tiers per domain), route matching.

modules.name: Protobuf Contracts
modules.description: Service definitions with HTTP annotations under sebuf framework. Managed by Buf. Generated client/server stubs in src/generated/. 35+ domain APIs.

modules.name: Cross-Platform Data
modules.description: JSON configs shared across platforms: market symbols, RSS domain lists, bootstrap tier cache keys. Authored source for api/_bootstrap-tier-keys.js.

modules.name: API Gateway
modules.description: Domain gateway factory producing per-domain handler chains: CORS origin validation → API key / session / HMAC auth → rate limit → handler → response. Replaces per-endpoint boilerplate.

modules.name: MCP Tool Registry
modules.description: MCP server endpoints and tool registry. A2A endpoint, NLWeb /ask endpoint, tool suggestion engine (token-overlap scoring). Concierge routing for agent consumption.

modules.name: Desktop Shell
modules.description: Tauri desktop app. WebView + Node.js sidecar process. Desktop-specific auth flows (tauri://localhost origins). Version synced via scripts.

modules.name: Bootstrap Hydration Pipeline
modules.description: Multi-tier bulk data hydration. Fast (15min TTL) and slow (60min TTL) tiers. R2-staged pre-computed payloads with S3-compatible access via aws4fetch. Cache-key registry synchronized from shared/.

modules.name: Auth & Identity Layer
modules.description: Multi-mechanism auth: HMAC-signed session tokens (wms_ prefix), enterprise API keys, HMAC grant tokens for cross-subdomain OAuth flow, PKCE S256 verification. Desktop origins recognized via allowlist.

modules.name: Idempotency Layer
modules.description: Standalone idempotency via Redis. SHA-256 request hash keyed on (pathname + scope + idempotency-key). Processing marker prevents double-execution; completed responses cached up to 24h. Replay detection for safe retry.

modules.name: Rate Limiting
modules.description: Sliding-window rate limit via Upstash Redis. Cloudflare edge-proof header (x-wm-edge-proof) prevents IP spoofing. Degraded mode (X-RateLimit-Mode: degraded) on Redis outage. IETF RateLimit headers exposed cross-origin.

modules.name: Security & Compliance Scripts
modules.description: Lint/audit scripts: API contract enforcement, rate-limit policy checks, premium-fetch gating, safe-HTML, unicode safety, local-secret-dump detection, Vite env secret checks, Mintlify reserved slug enforcement.

modules.name: CI/CD & Ops
modules.description: CI pipeline includes lint (biome + 10 custom checks), docs:check (capability counts derived from code), version:check (desktop version sync), sync:locales, sync:bootstrap-tier-keys.

control_flow: Browser SPA bootstrap: load → variant config → bootstrap tier detection (fast/slow) → fetch /api/bootstrap?tier=X&public=1 → hydrate panels + map

API request lifecycle: Edge Function entry → getCorsHeaders → getClientIp (CF proof) → rate limit check → validateApiKey (session token / API key / HMAC grant) → domain handler → Redis cache read/write → jsonResponse

Bootstrap hydration pipeline: scheduled publisher → assemble tier payload from Redis keys (35+ domains) → R2 put (pre-computed JSON) → Edge Function /api/bootstrap → R2 get → serve with freshness headers
MCP/A2A tool suggestion: user query → tokenize (stopword filter, length≥3) → TOOL_REGISTRY overlap scoring (name=3pts, description=1pt) → top-5 ranked suggestions → LLM tool selection
Idempotent write flow: request with Idempotency-Key → Redis GET (replay? → return cached) → SET processing marker (180s TTL) → execute handler → SET completed response (24h TTL) → respond
OAuth Pro-MCP flow: U3 consent page → HMAC grant mint (userId+nonce+exp) → redirect to api subdomain → U5 verify grant + Redis one-shot → OAuth authorization code → token exchange

SSRF protection: allowed origins validation in _cors.js against strict allowlist (worldmonitor.app and variants); CF edge-proof header validates request transited Cloudflare before trusting cf-connecting-ip
Worker-based analysis: src/workers/ (ML/ONNX inference, vector DB queries) runs off-main-thread; results merged into panel state via postMessage
data_flow: Upstream → Edge Function → Upstash Redis → Browser SPA: 35+ source groups (Finnhub, OpenSky, ACLED, GDELT, etc.) fetched by Edge Functions, cached in Redis with per-key TTL, served to browser via REST endpoints

Redis → R2 → Edge Function → Browser: bootstrap tier flow. Publisher aggregates 35+ Redis cache keys into single pre-computed JSON, stages to R2. Browser GET /api/bootstrap fetches from R2, bypassing Redis fan-out
Bidirectional JSON-RPC via /api/a2a and /api/ask: agent sends structured query → concierge routes to MCP tools → tool response → formatted response. Uses SSE streaming via Last-Event-ID
Session token flow: client POST to /api/wm-session → server HMAC-SHA-256 signs {userId, exp} → returns wms_-prefixed token → client sets Cookie → subsequent requests carry cookie for auth
Desktop sidecar IPC: Tauri WebView ↔ Node.js sidecar (child-process shim in src/shims/). Sidecar handles CORS-localhost proxy, desktop-specific API key management, file system access
Variant config flow: VITE_VARIANT env var → src/config/variant/ loads domain-specific panel/layer configs → UI renders variant-specific map layers and panel grid
Locales pipeline: src/locales/ (i18n JSON) → scripts/sync-locale-keys.mjs enforces key completeness across locales → loaded at runtime by SPA

plugin_points: Variant system: VITE_VARIANT env var (full/tech/finance/commodity/happy/energy) selects per-variant panel/layer/config from src/config/ — no code fork needed per deployment
public_api: REST API via Vercel Edge Functions: 35+ domain-specific endpoints under api/<domain>/ with protobuf-contract validation
Bootstrap hydration endpoint: GET /api/bootstrap?tier=fast|slow&public=1 — pre-computed bulk data payload from R2
MCP server at /api/mcp/ — tool listing + invocation via JSON-RPC over HTTP with SSE streaming
A2A endpoint at /api/a2a — agent-to-agent communication with tool suggestion + concierge routing
NLWeb /ask endpoint at /api/ask — natural language query interface using same tool suggestion engine
OAuth endpoints: /api/oauth/authorize-pro (Pro MCP grant), /api/oauth/protected-resource (RFC 9728 metadata), /api/oauth/authorization-server (RFC 8414 metadata)
Health check: GET /api/health — availability probe for monitoring
npm package (worldmonitor) — programmatic SDK/CLI for non-browser consumers
Embeddable widget: src/embed/ — lightweight loader for embedding panels in third-party sites
Documentation + discovery: /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json (agent skills), /.well-known/api-catalog (RFC 9727 API catalog), /docs/ (Mintlify documentation)

major_changes.change: CORS security hardening (#3541, #3554): removed trust of client-controlled headers (Origin/Referer/Sec-Fetch-Site) for auth bypass. All browser requests now require explicit session token or API key.
major_changes.impact: Breaking change for header-only trust path; eliminated IP-spoofing vector for rate-limit bypass

major_changes.change: Bootstrap pipeline: from Redis fan-out per-key fetch to pre-computed R2 staged payloads with fast/slow tier isolation
major_changes.impact: Reduced bootstrap latency from N Redis round-trips to single R2 GET; enabled freshness-tier separation (15min vs 60min)

major_changes.change: CORS preflight from Vercel afterFiles rewrite to filesystem catch-all (api/[...notfound].ts): fixed dynamic [rpc].ts gateway shadow bug (#4698, #4724)
major_changes.impact: All 35+ versioned REST gateways became reachable; eliminated silent 404 on dynamic routes

major_changes.change: MCP protocol integration: added A2A endpoint, tool registry, NLWeb ask endpoint, OAuth Pro grant flow, HMAC cross-subdomain grant tokens
major_changes.impact: Enabled AI agent consumption; added OAuth-based pro subscription gating for agent access

major_changes.change: Variant deployment system: introduced tech/finance/commodity/happy/energy variants as compile-time VITE_VARIANT selections
major_changes.impact: Single codebase deploys 6 independent branded apps with per-variant panel/layer configs; zero fork maintenance

major_changes.change: Rate limit hardening: added Cloudflare edge-proof header (x-wm-edge-proof) to verify request transited CF before trusting cf-connecting-ip
major_changes.impact: Prevented direct-to-origin IP spoofing for rate-limit bucket rotation; degraded mode on Redis outage

major_changes.change: Idempotency layer: Redis-backed standalone idempotency for write endpoints using SHA-256 request hash + processing marker
major_changes.impact: Safe retry on network errors without double-execution; 24h response caching for replay

major_changes.change: From monolithic Edge Functions to domain gateway factory pattern (server/gateway.ts)
major_changes.impact: Eliminated per-endpoint boilerplate; centralized CORS/auth/cache-tier configuration

major_changes.change: Desktop support: Tauri with Node.js sidecar, version sync scripts, desktop-specific auth origins (tauri://localhost)
major_changes.impact: Added native desktop distribution alongside web SPA; shared auth layer extended to desktop CORS patterns

major_changes.change: Protobuf-first API contracts: sebuf framework with Buf-managed proto definitions and generated stubs
major_changes.impact: Enforced API contract between server and client; auto-generated types from proto definitions

evolution.current_direction: Knowledge-centric intelligence platform: expanding from passive dashboard to proactive agent-accessible system. Key vectors include MCP/A2A protocol surface for AI consumption, multi-platform delivery (web/desktop/SDK/CLI/embeds), pre-computed bootstrap payloads for instant hydration, and increasingly automated security posture (custom lint scripts for API contract, rate-limit policy, premium gating, secret detection). Variant system enables domain-specialized deployments from a single codebase without fork overhead.
